fullContentHtml:
Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Date 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the Typing Test Date for the post of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) & Personal Assistant (PA). This recruitment has been issued for 150 posts. The online application process for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 15 September 2026, to 05 October 2026. The SPA Examination is going to Conducted on 14 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Date 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Window : 12 October 2026
  • SPA Exam Date : 14 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Typing Test Date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can Check the Typing Test Date from the official website of CISF also.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, BC, Female : Rs. 1300/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Check Typing Test Date Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Date 2026?

Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Date 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
